messages.content: 你是 Barbet 的資料判讀助理，使用臺灣繁體中文。請依據輸入、任務規格與可引用的證據，判斷候選結果並執行指定操作。忠實保留來源內容與識別碼；證據不足時，依任務規格棄答或交由人工確認。請遵守 response_format 指定的輸出格式。

BARBET_SFT_REQUEST_V3(payload={"inputs":[{"id":"src","type":"mt_source","units":[{"id":"src:u01","text":"Project TW-BGD2-198068 is managed by 青禾文件實驗室."},{"id":"src:u02","text":"Deployment is scheduled for 2030-01-19 in 屏東縣."},{"id":"src:u03","text":"The approved amount is TWD 4,678,400."}]},{"id":"ref","type":"mt_reference","units":[{"id":"ref:u01","text":"TW-BGD2-198068計畫由青禾文件實驗室負責。"},{"id":"ref:u02","text":"部署日期為2030 年 1 月 19 日，地點在屏東縣。"},{"id":"ref:u03","text":"核定金額為新臺幣 4,678,400 元。"}]},{"id":"hyp","type":"mt_candidate","units":[{"id":"hyp:u01","text":"TW-BGD2-198068計畫由青禾文件實驗室負責。"},{"id":"hyp:u02","text":"部署日期為2030 年 1 月 20 日，地點在屏東縣。"},{"id":"hyp:u03","text":"核定金額為新臺幣 4,678,400 元。"}]}],"primitive":"EDIT","response_format":{"empty_target_example":"{\"schema\":\"barbet.bgd.target/v2\",\"target\":{}}","instruction":"輸出單一 JSON 物件，且只包含 schema 與 target 兩個最外層欄位。只填入有輸入證據支持的結果，不要加上 Markdown 程式碼區塊或額外說明。","serializer":"JSON","serializer_version":"2","target_schema":"barbet.bgd.target/v2"},"schema":"barbet.sft.request/v3","task_family":"MT_POST_EDIT","task_spec":{"abstention_allowed":false,"allowed_actions":["EDIT"],"allowed_error_types":["MISSING_REALIZATION","UNSUPPORTED_ADDITION","VALUE_CORRUPTION","IDENTITY_MISMATCH","ORDER_VIOLATION","BOUNDARY_SHIFT","DUPLICATION","STRUCTURE_BREAK","CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION","INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"],"allowed_labels":["FAIL"],"constraints":{},"instruction":"比較可見來源、候選與限制，只執行有證據支持的最小修正。","output_contract":"decision+evidence+confidence+typed_action","query":"本次任務要求如下，請附上決定性依據：依英文來源與繁中參照，最小後編修候選譯文中的數值錯誤。","requested_schema":{},"required_evidence":true}})
